units.source_text: 手指甲掐上了固沙的草包，剥落下来也毫不在意，全然不顾地爬了上来。

en.t: His fingernails dug into the straw bags that held back the sand, and even when they tore loose he paid no attention, climbing up without caring at all.
Look, he was already on level ground!

units.source_text: 即使脱开手也不必担心掉下去了。

en.t: Even if he let go, he no longer had to worry about falling down.

units.source_text: 然而，他还是紧紧抱着草袋子，好一会儿，都松不开臂膀上的力量。

en.t: And yet he still clung tightly to the straw bag, and for a long while he could not loosen the strength in his arms.
